tagline: Spec phases layered on the Ralph autonomous loop.
keyFeatures: Five spec phases — research → requirements → design → tasks → implement — with state files
Phase-dedicated sub-agents keep each phase's context clean
Fresh context per task via the underlying Ralph loop
Codebase indexing spans URLs, MCP servers, and installed skills
Alternate ralph-speckit flavor mirrors spec-kit's phases
limitations: Solo maintainer with a sparse commit cadence (~2 commits Mar–Jul 2026)
Sequential task-by-task execution — [P] markers only flag parallel-safe tasks
Plugin for Claude Code / Codex — not standalone
No dashboard — progress lives in state files
